svg.title: How a committed change reaches every open page
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.text: the fastest sets the page clock; countdowns round up
behind the auction.realtime flag; it only sends a keepalive

g.data-edge-label: hello: the lot at its version

g.text: hello: the lot at its version
clock read after the lock; version rises
best effort; the next change heals it
the alarm re-arms to the next deadline
at most one frame a second
pages show Closed, no result yet

g.data-edge-label: extends or closes under the lock

g.text: extends or closes under the lock
idempotent; settling twice is a no-op

g.data-edge-label: state: the result, or a later close

g.text: state: the result, or a later close

g.data-edge-label: a read finds the lot overdue

g.text: a read finds the lot overdue
2 s or more past its deadline; alarm lost
skips a lot another transaction holds
the net; each hit counts as a repair
